vocab.meaning_vi: chia sẻ khối lượng công việc
vocab.example: We shared the workload fairly, so nobody had to work at the weekend.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi chia việc công bằng, nên không ai phải làm vào cuối tuần.

vocab.example: Our common goal was to release the app before the summer campaign.
vocab.example_vi: Mục tiêu chung của chúng tôi là ra mắt ứng dụng trước chiến dịch mùa hè.

vocab.meaning_vi: ghi nhận công lao của người khác
vocab.example: In the final report I gave credit to the two testers who found the issue.
vocab.example_vi: Trong báo cáo cuối, tôi đã ghi nhận công của hai bạn kiểm thử đã tìm ra lỗi.

vocab.meaning_vi: lắng nghe ý kiến người khác
vocab.example: I try to listen to others before I explain my own idea.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi cố gắng lắng nghe người khác trước khi trình bày ý của mình.

vocab.meaning_vi: xử lý bất đồng ý kiến
vocab.example: I handle disagreement by asking for data instead of raising my voice.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi xử lý bất đồng bằng cách hỏi số liệu thay vì lớn tiếng.

vocab.meaning_vi: chủ động làm việc gì đó
vocab.example: I took the initiative to write a short guide for the whole team.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã chủ động viết một bản hướng dẫn ngắn cho cả nhóm.

vocab.meaning_vi: đáng tin cậy, làm đúng cam kết
vocab.example: My teammates say I am reliable because I always finish what I promise.
vocab.example_vi: Đồng nghiệp nói tôi đáng tin cậy vì tôi luôn hoàn thành điều đã hứa.

vocab.example: Small updates every day helped me build trust with the client team.
vocab.example_vi: Những cập nhật nhỏ mỗi ngày giúp tôi xây dựng lòng tin với nhóm khách hàng.

listening.title: Interview questions about working in a team

lines.speaker: Huong (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Duc, tell me about a team project where you played an important part.

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Last year my team of five built a booking website in three months.

lines.speaker: Huong (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: What was your role in that team?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I handled the payment part, and I also helped the team share the workload each week.

lines.speaker: Huong (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: How did you deal with different opinions inside the group?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I handle disagreement with data. I ask people to show numbers, then we decide together.

lines.speaker: Huong (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Can you give me one concrete example?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: Two members wanted different payment gateways. We tested both for a week and chose the faster one.

lines.speaker: Huong (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Good. And what did you do when the deadline became difficult?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: I took the initiative to write a short setup guide, so new members needed less support.

lines.speaker: Huong (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: What was the result at the end?

lines.speaker: Duc (Candidate)
lines.text: We reached our common goal two days early, and I gave credit to the testers in the report.

questions.q: What was Duc responsible for in the project?

options: He asks for data and decides with the team
He asks the manager to choose

questions.q: What was the final result of the project?

shadowing: In my last project, our team shared the workload so nobody felt overloaded.
I always give credit to teammates who help me finish a difficult task.
When we disagreed, I listened to others first and then suggested a solution.
I took the initiative to write a short guide, and the team used it.
As a result, we reached our common goal two days before the deadline.
